title: docs(adr): ADR-0105 status flip — Phase 2 D8/D9 implemented; D8's role channel closed by ADR-0108
body:
Part of the 2026-07-30 re-evaluation of #3541 (tracking: ADR-0105).

## Why

The ADR's status line still read **"Phase 0/1 implemented (#3559)"** while both Phase 2 product decisions landed on 2026-07-28:

- **D8 — scoped invitations**, end-to-end: #3645 (host seam) → #3663 (placement engine) → #3674 (`/security/my-delegable-scope`) → #3695 (issuer-grant resolution) → #3722 (`delegated_admin` + invitation role cap, closing #3697) → #3767 (`sys_member` joins `GOVERNED_OBJECTS`); console objectstack-ai/objectui#2868 / objectstack-ai/objectui#2891; e2e objectstack-ai/cloud#886.
- **D9 — cross-org approval targeting**: #3824 (the D9 section was amended in that PR) + #3873 (directory-less approver types refuse instead of silently ignoring).

The body text was already current (the D9 amendment shipped with #3824); only the header lagged. This follows the existing status-flip convention (e.g. ADR-0062 in #3992).

## What

- Status line records D8/D9 implemented with the PR chain, cross-references [ADR-0108](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/blob/main/docs/adr/0108-membership-grade-is-not-a-capability-channel.md) (which closes the membership-role vocabulary D8's placement model replaces), and states the Phase 2 remainder: D10 reserved pending its follow-up ADR, D13 not started.
- Empty (docs-only) changeset — releases nothing.
